GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat rail 4l off, off rail turn, Straightened Up 3l off, off heels approaching 200m, 1-2l off approaching 100m, hit line well late # best work late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After being slow to begin was inconvenienced shortly after. Held up rounding the home turn and near the 350m was shifted outwards to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well # back/home ok
Jumped Ok eased to last 8 lengths. well back turn. hooked very Wide in Straight . 5 lengths. ran on very strongly # big win
Jumped Ok drifted back 10l off, improved Wide turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, found little, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat near last 5l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on well # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and brushed. Passing the 200m was bumped and was then struck by the whip of another rider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got up fence turn 4 lengths. battled away # Even Effort

Began fairly. Rolled fwd & raced 5th Two Wide (3L from lead) early . Stayed same until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 600m. Pushed out Four Wide @ 450m & pushed to quicken Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & weakened in last 200m. # didn't finish off
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn. made some ground # Never Likely
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn. Held Ground # Not Sighted

Jumped Well but soon Drifted Back Settled Down Two Wide 7th, 6 Lengths @ 1000m. at tail into Straight Hooked Out widest Straightening Up all Clear . wound up and had last crack final two bounds # good from the back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 600m shifted out and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide with cover 5 lengths. very Wide turn 5 lengths. made some ground # covered ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride his mount 1kg overweight in accordance with the policy.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield on inside (5L from lead). Stayed same midrace & improving slowly on inside from 550m. Eased 3 Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 300m & held ground 3 Wide in alst 200m. # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On return to scale rider advised that on straightening, when racing to the inside of other runners, he was unable to shift wider in search of firmer and more preferable ground.
